scope: Numerical model and synthetic controls only; no physical experiment has run.

sampling_example.note: Nyquist is necessary, not sufficient: require a calibrated analog passband and anti-alias filter. 1/T is Fourier-bin spacing, not a universal fitted-frequency uncertainty. Ringdown uses Q=1/(2*zeta) and the undamped natural frequency. The linewidth f/Q is a weak-damping approximation.

uncertainty_example.note: First-order independent-input standard uncertainty, excluding model bias, anisotropy, support, thermal drift and parameter covariance. It is not the uncertainty of an A/B measured frequency difference.

synthetic_path_example.disclaimer: Synthetic deterministic example, not measured copper data. Three selected radial modes only. Added-spring shifts use an illustrative effective modal mass and do not predict a real table-contact shift.

synthetic_contact_example.disclaimer: Synthetic deterministic example, not measured copper data. Three selected radial modes only. Added-spring shifts use an illustrative effective modal mass and do not predict a real table-contact shift.
